text.en: The final round in the magazine deals bonus damage, drawing from the wielder's life force, and then regenerates itself. Rapidly defeating three targets restores health.

Weapon of Sorrow.

The last round of this gun's magazine deals <pve 140% /> <pvp [30%] /> increased damage, drains 7 HP, and is always refunded when shot. Health drain is not lethal.

Scoring kills or activating 'Charged With Blight' restores 105 HP and begins Health Regeneration.

Healing Activation from kills is based on <link Combatant Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Minors: 33.4% 
• Elites, Minibosses, and Bosses: 100%
• Players: 66.7%
